name: Pakistan
summary: South Asian country in the Indus Basin facing severe winter particulate air pollution episodes in Punjab and Sindh, compounded by monsoon flood volatility and Karakoram-Himalayan glacial melt risks.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 13.36x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); acute winter inversion smog severely impacts Lahore and Faisalabad.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; frequent pre-monsoon heatwaves exceeding 48 °C in Jacobabad and interior Sindh.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across the Indus agricultural plain over trailing 30-year observational window.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.6% share of global fossil emissions; modest historical industrial footprint.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Less than one-fifth the global average per capita emission rate.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Critically low forest cover ~37,000 km²; Ten Billion Tree Tsunami initiative targeting mangrove and upland restoration.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Indus River hydroelectric dams (Tarbela, Mangla) provide 31.4% of electricity alongside nascent solar and wind.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 312 people/km²; urban population fraction is 37.4%.
